units.translation: The word ὦ [O] with the vocative is never accented on the ultima, even if the speech contains astonishment and wonder, e.g. ὦ Ἡράκλεις [O Heracles], ὦ θαῦμα θαυμάτων [O wonder of wonders]; for the ὦ [O] in these does not indicate the astonishment and wonder, but together with the vocatives; but when a genitive is added, it is necessarily accented on the ultima; for then it is always either exclamatory, e.g. ὦ τῆς ἐμῆς ἀθλιότητος [O my wretchedness], or expressing wonder, e.g. ὦ τοῦ ξένου μετάλλου [O the stranger's mine]. Therefore it also has the genitive added, with ἕνεκα [for the sake of] understood from outside.
